topStories.headline: Nvidia Beats Q2 Estimates, Projects $54B Q3 Revenue on AI Spending Surge
topStories.summary: Nvidia reported Q2 revenue of $46.74B (+56% YoY), beating the $46.06B estimate, and guided Q3 to $54B — above consensus of $53.1B — as CFO Colette Kress projected global AI infrastructure spending at $3–4 trillion by decade's end.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA ↑ pre-market; Nasdaq 100 futures ↑ ~1%; positive read for MRVL, AMD, and Asian AI chip suppliers SK Hynix and Samsung

topStories.headline: Jackson Hole Opens: Warsh Under Pressure to Clarify Rate Outlook in First Keynote
topStories.summary: The Fed's annual Jackson Hole symposium opened today with Chair Kevin Warsh scheduled to speak Friday; 80% of economists surveyed want him to detail his economic views, but 45% expect the communications-averse chair to offer no forward rate guidance.
topStories.marketImpact: Bond yields and USD ↑ risk on Friday; rate-sensitive assets (utilities, REITs, TLT) in focus; 40% probability of September rate hike priced in

topStories.headline: US Q2 GDP Revised Up to 1.5% as Consumer Spending and Business Investment Strengthened
topStories.summary: The second estimate of US Q2 GDP came in at an annualized 1.5% — above the initial reading — with consumer spending and business investment both revised upward, signaling more economic resilience than first thought.
topStories.marketImpact: Modest positive for equities; complicates Fed rate-cut timing; Fed funds futures show 40% chance of September hike

topStories.headline: US Eyes 7.5% Overcapacity Tariffs on China Ahead of Xi-Trump Summit
topStories.summary: Washington is considering a fresh 7.5% tariff on Chinese goods over excess manufacturing capacity ahead of a planned Xi-Trump summit next month, which would bring total US duties on China back to around 20% — the level Beijing considers consistent with its trade truce.
topStories.marketImpact: Chinese exporters and EV/solar makers ↓ watch; FXI and yuan under pressure; supply chain stocks across Asia affected

topStories.headline: Japan's Shinkin Banks and Life Insurers Face ~$194B in Bond Losses as Long Rates Rise
topStories.summary: Japan's community-focused shinkin banks are suffering mounting losses on their bond portfolios as long-term JGB yields rise, while major life insurers have accumulated nearly 31 trillion yen ($194B) in unrealized bond losses — up 60% year-on-year.
topStories.marketImpact: Japanese regional bank and insurer stocks ↓ watch; JGB yields elevated; lending capacity and capital ratios under strain

topStories.headline: Hong Kong Raises 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.5–4.5% After Strongest Q2 in Nearly 5 Years
topStories.summary: Hong Kong upgraded its full-year 2026 GDP forecast after the economy expanded 4.3% YoY in Q2 — its best in nearly five years — driven by booming AI-related electronics trade and a 13% surge in visitor arrivals to 26.71 million in H1.
topStories.marketImpact: Hang Seng ↑ bias; HK consumer, logistics, and tourism stocks in focus; positive confidence signal for the city

topStories.headline: Retail Earnings Deluge: Ulta, Dollar General, Dollar Tree, Best Buy, Hormel Report Today
topStories.summary: A major cluster of US consumer companies — Ulta Beauty, Dollar General, Dollar Tree, Best Buy, Hormel Foods, plus tech firms Marvell and Workday — report Q2 results today, providing a broad health check on US consumer spending under elevated interest rates.
topStories.marketImpact: ULTA, DG, DLTR, BBY, HRL all in focus for directional read on consumer resilience; MRVL results will offer another AI demand data point

topStories.headline: Japan's Record Budget Under Fire as Borrowing Costs Set to Double if JGB Yields Hit 2.5%
topStories.summary: Japan's record fiscal 2026 budget faces a dual test of stimulating the economy while keeping debt in check, with analysts warning that a surge in the 30-year JGB yield to 2.5% could double the country's borrowing costs and destabilize sovereign finances.
topStories.marketImpact: JGB yields ↑ watch; yen ↓ pressure; Japanese government bond ETFs and financials at risk; global spillover into US and EU yields possible

tickerDescriptions.NVDA: Nvidia Corporation, the dominant designer of AI accelerator GPUs and data center chips powering the global AI buildout

tickerDescriptions.SOXX: iShares Semiconductor ETF, tracking a broad index of US-listed semiconductor and chipmaker companies
tickerDescriptions.TLT: iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF, tracking long-duration US government bonds and sensitive to Fed rate expectations
tickerDescriptions.FXI: iShares China Large-Cap ETF, tracking the 50 largest Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong — a key proxy for China equity sentiment
tickerDescriptions.ULTA: Ulta Beauty Inc., the largest US specialty beauty retailer with over 1,300 stores offering cosmetics, skincare, and salon services
tickerDescriptions.DG: Dollar General Corp., a US discount retailer targeting budget-conscious consumers with over 19,000 stores nationwide
tickerDescriptions.DLTR: Dollar Tree Inc., a US discount retailer and parent of Family Dollar, operating thousands of value-priced stores across North America
tickerDescriptions.BBY: Best Buy Co., the largest US consumer electronics retailer selling devices, appliances, and technology services
tickerDescriptions.HRL: Hormel Foods Corporation, an American multinational food company known for brands including Spam, Skippy, Applegate, and Planters
tickerDescriptions.2800.HK: Tracker Fund of Hong Kong (TraHK), a passively managed ETF tracking the Hang Seng Index — the benchmark for Hong Kong equities
